input_identity: object_id unique; pool_id membership exactly matches ACTUAL_POOLS; reference_id equals current target; ordinary_manual only

outcomes.reduced: saved indicator fewer effective turns than reference; MSE is Brier loss after clipping linear prediction to [0,1]
outcomes.turn_deficit: saved nonnegative effective-turn deficit; MSE in turns squared
outcomes.bottom_bias_abs: absolute signed mean bottom-y bias among <=9degree matched rays, pixels in 1024x512; not mean absolute corner error
outcomes.unmatched: fraction of reference vertices not matched within 9degree; MSE, diagnostic not semantic correspondence
outcomes.Q: saved B8L2, MAE in score points
outcomes.time_old: log positive source-recorded seconds, inherited_v1_audited_source/usable only

outputs.INPUT_RECORDS.csv.gz: frozen joined 5719 records; raw fields unchanged; additional design/outcome columns
outputs.OOF_PREDICTIONS.csv.gz: unique object_id/outcome/model; observed, prediction, raw_prediction; mae,mse,bias per record
outputs.COMPARISONS.csv: model vs reference; improvement=reference_loss-model_loss; positive better; paired building conditional interval; primary loss fixed in PLAN
outputs.SOURCE_SUMMARY.csv: same OOF predictions, losses aggregated separately within source; not source-only refitting except time
outputs.GRADE_SUMMARY.csv: same OOF predictions, losses aggregated separately by unchanged grade
outputs.COEFFICIENTS.csv: training-fold coefficients, numeric per training SD; not causal effects; categorical penalized and not directly comparable to numeric
outputs.SUPPORT.csv: per-outcome effective support/missing count; time missing count includes other source
outputs.FOLD_SUPPORT.csv: train/test support and workers unseen outside heldout building
outputs.CHECKS.json: join, support and fold validation receipt

missingness: No zero-filled outcomes or time. Conditional short span design is zero only for no-short-edge with explicit indicator; missing short span when short edges exist is error. No same-target duration claim for source time.
model_scope: 22-building retrospective LOBO, ordinary Manual only; no new official difficulty labels; no personnel refit, fusion or scoring
uncertainty: 5000 paired building resamples of existing OOF losses; overlapping training sets, selected existing buildings, no refitting; descriptive conditional intervals, not causal or fresh external validation
